parsed_json.up: Select the first 1000 IC50 activity rows with pChEMBL values for the human single-protein target CHEMBL3921 (Heparanase). Filter activities to standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', and pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Join activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, and activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno. Filter target_dictionary to chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3921', target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', and tax_id = 9606. Join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Sort rows by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows.
